subject: Onetrust onboarding and ongoing portal healthcheck
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brighthealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding (OneTrust) + periodic healthcheck

Sergio —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our procurement and infosec teams want Redwood added to our OneTrust vendor portal so BrightHealth can complete a CAIQ and request SOC 2 artifacts. Two asks to get started: 

1) Can you confirm who should be the primary contact in your tenant (name/email + role)?
2) We run a quarterly portal healthcheck where we ask vendors to confirm evidence is current and rotate any stale items — can Redwood commit to a quarterly cadence?

If possible, please upload a short SOC 2 summary and a network diagram; I attached the onboarding checklist we use.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Security Program Manager
BrightHealth

Attachments: bright-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding (OneTrust) + periodic healthcheck

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick answers inline: 

1) Primary contact: Mina Haddad (Security & Compliance Lead) — mina_haddad@redwood.ai (she’ll be the user we provision in your OneTrust tenant).
2) Quarterly cadence: yes, we can commit to quarterly confirmations and will flag any control/regression items proactively.

I attached a brief SOC 2 summary (high level) and a portal screenshot showing our current evidence layout to speed validation. For the portal invite, can you send the OneTrust vendor invite link or tenant id?

Action items: 
- Mina to accept invite + start CAIQ pre-fill once invite arrives.
- Marissa to coordinate any procurement questions (SLA/contract references).

Thanks —
Sergio
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 95KB); onetrust-portal-screenshot.png (png, 230KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brighthealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding (OneTrust) + periodic healthcheck

Hi Elena —

Thanks, forwarding that invite to me is perfect. A couple notes so the CAIQ upload goes smoothly: 
- We prefer a tenant-level invite (vendor admin) so we can upload the CAIQ and mapped artifacts in one session.
- If you have sections of the CAIQ pre-mapped to your internal control IDs, please attach that mapping — it reduces back-and-forth.
- For evidence rotation: we rotate pen test reports and some infra diagrams annually; configuration screenshots and procedures are refreshed quarterly.

If BrightHealth needs a short walkthrough, I can schedule a 30-minute session to show where we place evidence and how we annotate answers (helps your review team).

Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brighthealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-24T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding (OneTrust) + periodic healthcheck

Thanks — invite sent (vendor admin). Link: https://app.onetrust.com/vendor/refresh/BRIGHT-INVITE-9f8a

We also attached our CAIQ mapping and a short reviewer checklist. We'll aim to complete our side within two weeks after you accept. A walkthrough next week Wednesday at 10am ET would be great.

Elena

Attachments: bright-caiq-mapping.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB); review-checklist.pdf (pdf, 25KB)
